correctness.rationale: RESULT.md establishes an exact independent two-uniform-coupon-stream coupling conditional on reset indicators. The part chain [[r,1-r],[1,0]] has stationary frequencies (1/(2-r),(1-r)/(2-r)); move counts to B and A have means (1-r)/(2-r)t and (1-r)^2/(2-r)t and variance O(t). At t=((2-r)/(1-r))n(log n+x), fluctuations are o_P(n). Coupon missing-count factorial moments and deterministic upper/lower count sandwiches yield independent Gumbel limits, with A intensity c=(1-r)exp(lambda/(1-r)). The max CDF and logistic last-covered side follow from independent continuous Gumbels. Starting root already visited and no simultaneous completion are correctly handled. Local independent_checks.py compares direct labelled finite-state evolution against the two streams for small bicliques; experiments are corroboration rather than a proof of the asymptotic.
residual_risks: Only fixed 0<r<1 and fixed lambda with both part sizes tending to infinity are proved; no uniformity in r or lambda.
